runtime_plan.request_partition: one independent saturation request per source fiber to remain below the public calculator gateway timeout

proof_composition.group_theory_adapter: a saturated rank-r subgroup of a free abelian group of rank r is the whole free group
proof_composition.source_index_check: exact IsLinearlyIndependent torsion relations express the source basis in the saturated basis and give determinant/index
